title: Class Composition
prompt:
Write three classes in `solution.py` that demonstrate object composition:

**Requirements:**
1. `Address(street, city, zip_code)` -- stores street, city, and zip_code attributes
2. `Person(name, age, address)` -- stores name, age, and an Address instance; has a `summary(self)` method returning `"{name}, age {age}, {city}"`
3. `Roster(name)` -- stores a name and an internal list of people; has `add_person(self, person)` to add a person, and `find_by_city(self, city)` returning a list of persons whose address matches the given city

**Examples:**
```python
addr = Address("123 Main St", "Springfield", "62704")
person = Person("Alice", 30, addr)
person.summary()  # "Alice, age 30, Springfield"

roster = Roster("Team")
roster.add_person(person)
roster.find_by_city("Springfield")  # [person]
roster.find_by_city("Shelbyville")  # []
```
hints: Composition: Person has-an Address (stored as attribute)
List comprehension to filter: [p for p in self.people if ...]
Each class has its own __init__ to set up its attributes
